nodes.description: Public state variable holding the hardcoded Chainlink oracle address (0xDC3EA94CD0AC27d9A86C180091e7f78C683d3699) used as the price source; it has no setter so it cannot be changed after deployment.
External view function getPrice() that reads the Chainlink oracle and returns its latestAnswer scaled down by 100 for the SNX-USDC (decimals=6) conversion.
External call IChainlink(chainlink).latestAnswer() whose return value is used without any sanity, staleness or validity check, trusting the oracle address stored in state.
Arithmetic operation latestAnswer() / 100 which truncates the oracle answer to convert 8-decimal Chainlink data; unchecked precision loss / division behavior.

edges.reason: The getPrice function reads the chainlink state variable to know which oracle contract to query.
The chainlink state variable is used as the target address of the external latestAnswer() call, so its value flows into the call.
Execution of getPrice invokes the external IChainlink.latestAnswer() call as its first statement.
The value returned by latestAnswer() is the dividend of the / 100 division, so oracle output dataflows into the arithmetic operation and can drive precision loss.
